description: This file implements a React component 'MindmapCanvas' that renders an interactive mind map diagram related to career transitions. It includes functions for layout computation, node rendering, edges visualization, zooming, panning, and node interaction handling, specifically tailored for a fixed, design-matching visual structure.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Limits a number within the specified min and max bounds.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts an unknown input to a trimmed string, handling nullish values gracefully.

methods.name: numberOrNull
methods.description: Parses an unknown value as a finite number or returns null if invalid.

methods.name: extractPercentRange
methods.description: Attempts to extract a percentage range from node properties or title using regex and heuristics.

methods.name: isLikelyStepNode
methods.description: Heuristically determines if a node appears to be a 'step' in the mindmap based on its type or title.

methods.name: computeLevels
methods.description: Calculates hierarchical levels for nodes based on graph structure starting from a center node.

methods.name: nodeLane
methods.description: Assigns a layout lane to a node based on its properties and positional heuristics.

methods.name: buildAdjacency
methods.description: Builds adjacency lists for outgoing and incoming edges.

methods.name: chooseRightPrimary
methods.description: Selects the primary right node based on level depth.

methods.name: computeLayout
methods.description: Computes fixed positions for nodes and connections to match the design layout, including special handling for sub-branches and clusters.

methods.name: wrapLabel
methods.description: Wraps a label string into multiple lines respecting max character count and line limits, adding ellipsis when necessary.

methods.name: MindmapCanvas
methods.description: React component rendering an interactive, fixed-layout career mind map with zoom, pan, and node interaction features.
